name: The Haunted Isle
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Baron Revilgaz has had me keep an ear out for rumors of the strange and out-of-place in Booty Bay and Stranglethorn. I don't usually put much stock in ghost stories, but I heard some sailors in the tavern talking about a haunted island off the coast. Water elementals and a raving goblin ghost, they say.

If you're going to go talk to Revilgaz, could you relay that story to him?
narrative.objectives: Speak with Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Interesting. Some time ago, I seem to remember reading a book once that suggested...

Ah, of course, a troll legend it was. If what Krazek reports is true, perhaps I will soon be able to add the Stone of the Tides to my collection of ancient artifacts and relics.

quests.objectiveText: Speak with Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

quests.name: The Stone of the Tides

quests.name: Water Elementals
quests.objectiveText: Acquire 6 Water Elemental Bracers for Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Magical Analysis
quests.objectiveText: Bring the water elemental bracers to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in Dalaran.

quests.name: Ansirem's Key
quests.objectiveText: Talk to Catelyn in Booty Bay.

quests.name: "Pretty Boy" Duncan
quests.objectiveText: Get Catelyn's dagger from "Pretty Boy" Duncan.

quests.name: The Curse of the Tides
quests.objectiveText: Destroy the Altar of the Tides with Catelyn's Blade, kill Gazban and bring the Stone of the Tides and Catelyn's Blade back to Baron Revilgaz.
